# gigahost_dns_zone_secondary (Resource)

Manages a secondary (slave) DNS zone that Gigahost transfers from one or more master servers. This uses `POST /dns/zones/secondary`, which is not part of the public API documentation but is used by the Gigahost panel. No endpoint for changing the masters of an existing zone is known, so changing `masters` replaces the zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "gigahost_dns_zone_secondary" "example" {
  zone_name = "example.com"
  masters   = ["192.0.2.1", "192.0.2.2"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `masters` (Set of String) IP addresses of the master servers to transfer the zone from. Changing this replaces the zone.
- `zone_name` (String) Domain name.

### Read-Only

- `zone_id` (String) Zone id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Secondary zones can be imported by their zone id.
terraform import gigahost_dns_zone_secondary.example 123
```
